prompt: Announce Carol from accounting's retirement party (34 years) as a WWE farewell match. Her music hits one last time.
response:
*LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... WELCOME TO MONDAY NIGHT LEDGER!* 

*(Cue crowd roaring, pyrotechnics exploding in the breakroom)*

BAH GAWD, look at the history in this arena! For 34 grueling years, through the Monday Night Wars, the dot-com bubble, and the Attitude Era of corporate restructuring, there has been ONE undisputed Champion of the Finance Department. 

She has survived 34 consecutive Tax Season Hell-in-a-Cell matches. She has delivered the Spreadsheet Suplex to every unbalanced budget that dared step foot in her cubicle. She is the reigning, defending, undisputed Heavyweight Champion of the Bottom Line... **CAROL FROM ACCOUNTING!**

But folks, father time is the only opponent nobody can pin. The rumors are true. After a legendary 34-year title reign, Carol is officially vacating the championship. She’s lacing up her sensible office shoes and leaving her calculator in the middle of the ring.

This Friday, we are hosting the Ultimate Farewell Match! 

**THE EVENT:** The Final Count: Carol’s Retirement Smackdown
**THE ARENA:** The Main Breakroom (a.k.a. The Corporate Squared Circle)
**THE BELL TIME:** 3:00 PM Sharp

There will be no disqualifications, no holds barred, and most importantly, free pizza and a championship cake! We’re calling out the entire roster—Sales, Marketing, HR, IT, and Operations—to come down the ramp and pay tribute to a true Hall of Famer. 

At 4:00 PM, we’re cutting the lights. We’re firing up the Titantron. And for the very last time, the glass is going to shatter, the crowd is going to go wild, and **CAROL’S MUSIC IS GOING TO HIT!** 

Don't miss your chance to shake the hand of the G.O.A.T. before she walks up that ramp and into the sunset of retirement. 

*AND THAT’S THE BOTTOM LINE, BECAUSE CAROL SAID SO!* 

*(Queue fading exit music and roaring applause)*
